brief-moves.moved.meaning: Says on a brief's move line that the person's Yes or Other time moved the item, with Undo beside it.

brief-moves.already-done.meaning: Says on a brief's move line that Already did it marked the item Completed.

brief-moves.staying.meaning: Says on a brief's move line that No (or Undo) keeps the item at its time.

brief-moves.never-move.meaning: Confirms that the brief will stop suggesting moves for this Behavior, and where to change that.
brief-moves.never-move.text: The brief won’t suggest moving {title} again; you can change this in its settings.

brief-moves.accept-all-explainer.meaning: Explains once, after the first Accept all, what Accept all and Undo all do.
brief-moves.accept-all-explainer.text: Accept all: moves every item above for today. Undo all puts them back.

brief-moves.batch-refused.meaning: Says how many items Accept all could not move; each refused line names its own reason.
brief-moves.batch-refused.text: {count, plural, one {One item could not be moved; see its line.} other {# items could not be moved; see their lines.}}
brief-moves.batch-refused.label: Not changed

brief-moves.calendar-stale.meaning: Says the calendar could not be read, so the brief offers no times that depend on it.
brief-moves.calendar-stale.text: Your calendar couldn’t be read just now, so times that depend on it aren’t offered.
brief-moves.calendar-stale.label: Calendar not current

brief-moves.no-time-fits.meaning: Says Re-plan found no other time that fits today.
brief-moves.no-time-fits.label: Not changed

brief-moves.no-other-free-time.meaning: Says in Other time that the planner found no other free start today, so the person picks one below.
brief-moves.no-other-free-time.text: No other free time found today.

brief-moves.replan-explainer.meaning: Explains under Re-plan that it plans again with the calendar as it is now.
brief-moves.replan-explainer.text: Re-plan finds a new time with what’s on your calendar now.

brief-moves.length-guess.meaning: Says the move line's length is Cadence's guess and offers to set it.

brief-moves.conflict.meaning: Says in the brief that a schedule edit put a moved item on top of another item, with Keep it here and Move it.
brief-moves.conflict.text: Your schedule change put {hasOther, select, no {another item at the same time} other {it on top of {other}}}.

brief-moves.request.offline.meaning: Says a move-line answer could not be sent because the device appears to be offline.
brief-moves.request.offline.label: Not changed

brief-moves.request.proposal-closed.meaning: Says another device already answered this move line.
brief-moves.request.proposal-closed.text: This suggestion was already answered on another device.
brief-moves.request.proposal-closed.label: Not changed

brief-moves.request.proposal-not-found.meaning: Says the move line no longer exists, and that a Refresh shows the current ones.
brief-moves.request.proposal-not-found.text: This suggestion is no longer available. Refresh the brief for current ones.
brief-moves.request.proposal-not-found.label: Not changed

brief-moves.request.revision-changed.meaning: Says the item changed after the brief was written, and that a Refresh shows it as it is.
brief-moves.request.revision-changed.text: This item changed since the brief was written; refresh the brief to see it.
brief-moves.request.revision-changed.label: Not changed

brief-moves.request.rate-limited.meaning: Says too many answers arrived at once and asks the person to wait a moment.
brief-moves.request.rate-limited.text: Too many changes at once. Try again in a moment.
brief-moves.request.rate-limited.label: Not changed

brief-moves.request.timeout.meaning: Says a move-line answer took too long and asks the person to try again.
brief-moves.request.timeout.text: That took too long; try again.
brief-moves.request.timeout.label: Not changed

brief-moves.request.failed.meaning: Says Cadence could not apply a move-line answer for a reason it cannot name.
brief-moves.request.failed.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.closed.meaning: Server refusal: this move line was already answered.
brief-moves.refused.closed.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.already-marked.meaning: Server refusal: the line's item was marked after the brief was written.
brief-moves.refused.already-marked.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.item-changed.meaning: Server refusal: the line's item changed after the brief was written.
brief-moves.refused.item-changed.text: {title} changed after this brief was written.
brief-moves.refused.item-changed.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.calendar-too-close.meaning: Server refusal: a calendar event added after the brief now sits too close to the line's time.
brief-moves.refused.calendar-too-close.text: {time} is too close to a calendar event now: {hasEvent, select, no {one was added} other {{event} was added}} after this brief was written.
brief-moves.refused.calendar-too-close.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.calendar-taken.meaning: Server refusal: a calendar event added after the brief now holds the line's time.
brief-moves.refused.calendar-taken.text: {time} is taken now: {hasEvent, select, no {a calendar event was added there} other {{event} was added to your calendar}} after this brief was written.
brief-moves.refused.calendar-taken.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.batch-too-close.meaning: Server refusal: the same Accept all just moved another item too close to this line's time.
brief-moves.refused.batch-too-close.text: {time} is too close to {title}, which Accept all just moved.
brief-moves.refused.batch-too-close.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.batch-taken.meaning: Server refusal: the same Accept all just moved another item into this line's time.
brief-moves.refused.batch-taken.text: {time} is taken: Accept all just moved {title} there.
brief-moves.refused.batch-taken.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.too-close-moved.meaning: Server refusal: the person moved another item too close to this line's time after the brief.
brief-moves.refused.too-close-moved.text: {time} is too close to {title} now: you moved it after this brief was written.
brief-moves.refused.too-close-moved.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.too-close-changed.meaning: Server refusal: another item changed after the brief and now sits too close to this line's time.
brief-moves.refused.too-close-changed.text: {time} is too close to {title} now: it changed after this brief was written.
brief-moves.refused.too-close-changed.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.too-close.meaning: Server refusal: another item sits closer to this line's time than the 10 minutes Cadence keeps.
brief-moves.refused.too-close.text: {time} is too close to {title}. Cadence keeps 10 minutes between items.
brief-moves.refused.too-close.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.taken-moved.meaning: Server refusal: the person moved another item into this line's time after the brief.
brief-moves.refused.taken-moved.text: {time} is taken now: you moved {title} there after this brief was written.
brief-moves.refused.taken-moved.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.taken-changed.meaning: Server refusal: another item changed after the brief and now holds this line's time.
brief-moves.refused.taken-changed.text: {time} is taken now: {title} changed after this brief was written.
brief-moves.refused.taken-changed.label: Not changed

brief-moves.refused.taken.meaning: Server refusal: another item holds this line's time.
brief-moves.refused.taken.label: Not changed

brief-moves.pairing.meaning: The reason on a brief pairing line (Ticket 361): do an alongside item during another of today's items, at that item's start. Cadence's own words when the model writes none.
